protocol: Pre-day chronological replay; current-source-season training only; prior-year international regional prior only; no team rating carryover
prior_international_scope: Previous source season MSI/MSC/Worlds including play-ins, EWC and First Stand; no domestic results
same_day_policy: All matches of one UTC source date share pre-day training data; no same-day updates
tie_policy: p=0.5 gets expected 0.5 accuracy credit, not arbitrarily choosing team1; disclose tied count
cold_start: Neutral team residual around previous regional prior; S3 excluded from replay due to insufficient pre-event data; unknown regions default 0
format_policy: Evaluation targets MSI/MSC/Worlds only; winning threshold determines BO1/3/5; domestic BO2 scores are retained as map evidence
caveats: S3/S4 domestic coverage is substantially incomplete in this source; these are source-snapshot replays, not full-history verified backtests
Reported aggregate is descriptive, not a held-out model-selection estimate; priors were specified without tuning to test outcomes
Model uncertainty and correlated maps make naive binomial standard errors inappropriate
Strict MLE coverage is selective; compare models on the same subset as well as full coverage
Teams use normalized source names within a season; no unverified organization-merger inference
